data.name: Maggie's Movies - Camera, Action!
data.detailed_description:
Hi there, nice to meet you! 😃 My name’s Maggie, and I'm an aspiring movie director! Can you help me follow my dream and make it in the world of showbiz?

Growing up in my grandfather's theater, I always had one dream - to become a movie director, and start making movies! Recently I got a job as a production assistant on the set of a real Hollywood movie called "Waves of Love". Will this be my big break? 🎦 🎥

🎬 HELP ME (Maggie!) FOLLOW MY DREAM and make it as a movie director in Hollywood
🎬 PLAY THROUGH 93 ENTERTAINING TIME MANAGEMENT LEVELS, consisting of 72 story levels and 21 challenge levels
🎬 HANDLE BEHIND THE SCENES DRAMA and deal with envious colleagues, celebrity divas, and other showstoppers!
🎬 DISCOVER 6 DIFFERENT LOCATIONS like my grandfather's theater, movie sets, and Hollywood parties
🎬 FILM AND DIRECT MY MOVIE and take care of the actors, the director, the dressing room and the make-up station
🎬 MEET A WIDE VARIETY OF INTERESTING CHARACTERSas I find out who my true friends are
🎬 EARN ALL THE TROPHIES to ensure everyone will be at the premiere of my first movie
🎬 COLLECT DIAMONDS to unlock famous movie memorabilia. Do you recognize them all?

Are you ready for the lights, the camera, and the action?

I've made it to Hollywood! I can't believe it's finally going to happen! This is what I’ve always dreamed of, and I can't wait to make my grandfather proud. It was hard to leave him and his theater behind, but I have to follow my dream.

Becoming a director will be hard though. I have a feeling some colleagues will do whatever it takes to make it here... And these celebrity actors! So many divas, and some who are almost impossible to satisfy. I'm not planning on changing, though. I’m gonna stick to my beliefs, the way my grandfather taught me.

With your help, I’m sure I can overcome all this drama behind the scenes and get my show on the road. Together, we're going to prove I have what it takes to reach for the stars! 🌠

Are you up for the role of a lifetime? Help me stay true to myself in this blockbuster time management game! 🎥 🎦

reviews.review:
[b]Maggie's Movies 1: Camera, Action! [/b](TM-Dash)
Steam copy provided for Curator review

[i]NOTE: The Steam version includes the challenges and bonus chapter, but not the 4 wallpapers that are included with CE versions purchased elsewhere.[/i]

Difficulty is chosen before you start, and is clearly defined. Pause a level to access separate sliders for Music and SFX, Show Game Hints and Full-screen.  From the main menu you can read bios for each character in the game, but be aware that they can include spoilers.
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2105725053
[b]Story[/b]:

Maggie spent a lot of time in her grandfather's theater, and grew up loving the cinema.  Getting a job as a production assistant brings her one step closer to of becoming a movie director, but dealing with big personalities and even bigger egos comes with the territory.  Help Maggie navigate volatile situations as she forges ever onward towards her dream!

This is a game that I put off playing for a while, because I didn't think I'd enjoy it.  I was pleasantly surprised to find that I really liked it!  There were some uncomfortable moments, for sure, but Maggie's strength of character is inspiring, and I appreciate where the story took us.

[b]Gameplay[/b]:

This is your typical [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/30274976]GameHouse Original Stories[/url]-type gameplay.  People automatically go to their stations and order, you grab items deliver them.  Chaining actions will get you point-bonuses, and Carl the Mouse is on every non-challenge level.  He does squeak, so that makes finding him easier. ;)
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2105710199
There are a couple of locations in addition to movie sets, including working in the theater -- my favorite part.  

[i]Maggie's Movies [/i]does [b]not [/b]have the pop-up mini-games (ie. moving the cursor around in a circle or quick-clicking to complete an action) that has become popular in the more recent offerings in the Snuggford-related games, something that I appreciate since I tend to have trouble with them.

We have a total of 60 story-related levels, [i]plus [/i]the [b]bonus chapter [/b]and challenge levels.  Speaking of which, the extra chapter is a prequel and is available from the moment you start the game!
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2105714681
The [b]24 in-game and Steam Achievements[/b] can be achieved by the usual catching-all-the-mice and getting-3-stars-on-every-level-type of thing, with no daily challenges, etc. to deal with.

Be aware that the English is not always perfect, but it's not terrible -- Easy enough to understand.  The text also sometimes gets partially cropped-off at the top of the screen, but again, it's readable.

[b]Verdict[/b]:

I love that Maggie simultaneously manages to be no-nonsense and sweet, driven but kind.  The movie theme of the game is not my favorite, but I ended up enjoying this one very much, and am looking forward to playing the 2nd game.  Recommended to TM-Dash fans!
